description.value: Millway Market is a convenience store and fuel stop operating under the Wayne Procter Group's Gas N Go division on Vancouver Island. Part of a long-established, locally owned Island business group, it aims to provide one-stop shopping combining fuel with everyday grocery items. Touring cyclists on MacMillan Road in Nanaimo will find it a practical resupply point.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website confirms Millway Market is an active Gas N Go division location at 1594 Macmillan Road, Nanaimo, V9X 1L9, consistent with the OSM record. The Gas N Go division description states locations offer 'not simply fuel but also groce[ries]', supporting basic groceries as a confirmed amenity. No evidence on the website or in OSM tags addresses bike parking, water, washrooms, or any other specific amenity for cyclists.
concerns: No store-specific phone number in OSM or on the location page; the corporate contact number (250-753-2540) listed on the website belongs to the head office at 106 Fry Street, not this location.
Minor address spelling discrepancy: OSM uses 'MacMillan Road' (capital M) while the website uses 'Macmillan Road' (lowercase m).
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, open, publicly accessible convenience store and gas station confirmed by the operator's own website; a practical resupply stop for touring cyclists.
